scenarios.title: Find architecture opportunities before choosing work
scenarios.prompt: The repository has a frequently changed order pipeline, a quiet legacy module, and an ADR that deliberately keeps billing separate. Use improve-codebase-architecture to show me the candidates first. Do not implement anything yet.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May list generic refactors or start designing an interface before the user selects a candidate.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Investigate recent hotspots with delegated exploration, respect the ADR, produce and open the full HTML candidate report with before/after visuals and recommendation strengths, then ask which candidate to explore; do not implement.

scenarios.title: Continue from the selected candidate
scenarios.prompt: I choose the Order intake candidate from your architecture report. Explore alternative interfaces. Our CONTEXT.md calls this an Order, and the repo has HTTP and in-memory payment adapters.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May present a single interface or redesign without the domain vocabulary.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Use codebase-design and its complete design-it-twice reference for distinct parallel designs, compare depth/locality/seam placement, and use grilling for unresolved decisions; record resolved terminology and offer ADRs only under the original criteria.
